title: SaaS Revenue Leakage: Trial, Churn & Billing Leaks Explained
description: Where SaaS companies leak revenue — trial conversion, activation, churn, failed payments, and expansion — with benchmarks and fixes.

faq.q: Where do SaaS companies leak the most revenue?
faq.a: Typically trial-to-paid conversion, early churn before activation, and involuntary churn from failed card charges.

faq.q: What is a good SaaS trial conversion rate?
faq.a: Varies by model; self-serve often targets 10–25% trial-to-paid. Below 5% with healthy signups usually signals a leak.

blocks.text: SaaS revenue leakage rarely shows up as one broken metric. It is usually a stack: trials that never activate, cards that fail silently, and customers who would upgrade but never see the right plan.

items: Trial signup without onboarding to first value
Pricing page mismatch vs actual buyer persona
Monthly churn above 5–7% without save flows
Failed payments with no Smart Retries or dunning
